notes: Site: ikiru.in (Shopify, India). Access: direct HTTP fetch throughout, HTTP 200, no WAF/block; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: fetched full /collections.json (965 collections across 4 pages), /pages.json (100 pages), homepage nav links, and /search/suggest.json queried for 'clearance', 'outlet', 'last chance', 'final sale', 'end of line' (all returned zero matching collections AND zero matching pages). No collection or page handle/title anywhere on the site contains 'clearance', 'outlet', 'final sale', 'last chance', 'end of line', or 'discontinued'. The site does expose many dated/seasonal promotional 'sale' collections discovered via collections.json: black-friday-sale-2025, diwali-festive-sale, end-of-season-sale-2025, freedom-sale, fy-end-sale-2026, grand-sale, great-home-decor-sale, ikiru-summer-sale-2026, mid-year-sale-2026, monsoon-sale, monsoon-sale-2026, new-year-sale, pre-festive-sale, republic-day-furniture-sale, republic-day-sale-2026, flash-sale, spring-summer-sale. Opened the rendered page (title + meta description) for every one of these: all read as generic limited-time/seasonal percent-off promotions ('Up to X% Off', 'Limited-time offers', tied to a named campaign/festival/fiscal period) with no clearance/outlet/permanent-markdown taxonomy signal -- matching the brief's explicit exclusion for 'a generic temporary promotional sale (seasonal sale, Black Friday, a percent-off campaign with no permanence signal)'. One exception investigated closely: 'end-of-season-sale-2025' -- its SEO meta description is a keyword-stuffed list that happens to include the literal phrase 'clearance sale furniture' among many other sale-type keywords (not a dedicated on-page taxonomy statement that the page itself is Clearance). Regardless, this collection currently has 0 products live on it (confirmed via exhaustive /collections/end-of-season-sale-2025/products.json paging), so per the zero-product-listings rule it is dropped entirely and not written as a row even considering the ambiguous keyword. No genuine Clearance/Outlet PLP exists on this site as of the time of this check.
